facts.fact: Kesu's grandson carries Ittan's cough-medicine jar and Devan's letter down the goat path at first light, since the pass is closed to carts.
facts.why: needed because the jar must reach Ittan's widow while the pass is shut.

facts.fact: Devan seals the letter to Ittan's household in plain black wax stamped with the warden's iron disc, and offers to pay from the account of Kettamala.
facts.why: needed to show the kindness on the page without using council or queen's wax.

facts.fact: The Resin House ledger is two kinds of leaf sewn into one cover: front half plain-ink contract leaves (the 'contract books'), back half resin-ink pages. The contract leaves come loose at the stitching.
facts.why: needed so the first term (contract books to the court, pages to owners) is physically possible.

facts.fact: Neela has one smear of Ammu's resin left in the pouch, kept for the Resin House; the other was spent earlier. The ache is close: nails split and a night sweat.
facts.why: needed for the beat where she keeps the last smear rather than turn tonight.

facts.fact: Neela tells Devan what the intake slip behind her burned page says ('Intake, sold at six years', two lines unread) and that she wants only to read it alone.
facts.why: needed for the disclosure ladder; reiterates F253 and does not add a plot fact.
